subject: Request: Pricing/Throughput match + SLA for GPU pool (AstralMed AST-4831)
messages:
From: Sam Kapoor <sam.kapoor@astralmed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@astralmed.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing request — committed GPU pool + throughput SLA (AST-4831)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at AstralMed is excited about Redwood's latency profile. We're working toward a committed GPU pool for inference across our document and triage workloads and want to get an apples-to-apples comparison against a competing offer.

Specifically:
- Target: 120 concurrent reserved A100-equivalent GPUs (expected avg seq length 1024)
- Required: 99th pct latency SLA (per request) and a 99.9% availability target for the pool
- Term: 12 month reserved commit, start date projected 2027-06-01
- Commercial ask: match the competitor's blended effective discount (they offered ~22% off list + $150k onboarding credit) or provide a counter that preserves their ARR economics

We have legal/procurement involved (cc'd). Can your team produce a proposal with throughput guarantees and an outline of any one-time credits for strategic terms? We are sensitive to timing; procurement would like an initial commercial term by COB Wednesday (2027-03-24).

Deal: AST-4831
Thanks,
Sam Kapoor
Head of ML Ops
AstralMed

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Kapoor <sam.kapoor@astralmed.com>
Cc: marus and internal <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing request — committed GPU pool + throughput SLA (AST-4831)

Sam — thanks for the clarity. Appreciate the target numbers. We're confident we can meet the latency and availability targets with our dedicated pool, but I'll need to coordinate an exception/approval for the level of credits and the blended discount you're asking for.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll pull together a pricing workbook with a matched throughput configuration and an initial commercial term sheet.
- Looping in Marcus (solutions) and Karthik (pricing) to size the pool and construct the proposal.
- I'll flag this to Ben in Sales for an exec credit exception if we need to go beyond standard flexibility.

Can you confirm: 1) whether the competitor's discount is guaranteed across the full 12 months or backloaded; and 2) whether your procurement needs a DocuSign-ready redline by 2027-03-24 COB?

I'll aim to get a proposal in your hands by EOD Tue that we can iterate on.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: AST-4831 pricing workbook (draft) + ask for credit exception

Folks — attaching a draft workbook (AST-4831_pricing_workbook.xlsx) and a short draft proposal (AST-4831_proposal_v1.pdf). Notes:
- Config: 120 A100-eq reserved GPUs, target sustained throughput ~950 tokens/sec across the pool (mixed seq lengths avg 1024)
- Baseline list price for the reserved commit comes to $1,050,000/yr; standard discount tier gives us 12% off list (customer pays $924k).
- To match the competitor economics (22% + $150k credit) we need either a deeper discount (~18–20%) plus a one-time onboarding credit (~$120k), or a larger one-time credit ($150k) with a slightly smaller discount.

Asking Ben for a one-time exception to authorize an onboarding credit up to $150k and allow the discount to go to 18% if needed. Marcus — please confirm throughput guarantees language we can commit to in the proposal and any fallback capacity notes.

Attachments: AST-4831_pricing_workbook.xlsx (pricing worksheet), AST-4831_proposal_v1.pdf (internal draft)

Karthik
Pricing Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AST-4831 pricing workbook (draft) + ask for credit exception

Team — quick read: AST looks strategic (healthcare + potential cross-sell). I can approve up to a $100k one-time onboarding credit on my authority, provided we keep the effective ARR impact within our win-zone. Any deeper credit or a discount past 15% needs Exec review.

Operational notes:
- Marcus: we can commit to a 99th pct per-request latency SLA measured on a 24-hour rolling window for the pool. Include a performance credits schedule in the contract (non-linear: small credits for transient misses, escalates for repeat violations).
- Karthik: update the workbook with the $100k credit path + a second column that shows the 18% discount + $120k credit scenario for Exec review.

Tessa — if the customer is firm on the competitor package, escalate to Aditya for final approval on the larger concession. Include HubSpot deal link when you send to him.

Ben
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AST-4831 pricing workbook (draft) + ask for credit exception

Ben / team — reviewed the workbook and Marcus's SLA note. I approve a one-time onboarding credit of $120,000 and a maximum concession up to 18% discount for a 12-month reserved commit for AstralMed, contingent on Legal approving the updated SLA wording and Revenue Ops recording the uplift. Conditions:
- Credit is one-time and amortized over the first invoice (clear in SOW)
- Discount cap 18% fixed for the 12-month term; renegotiation allowed at renewal
- We require a 60-day notice if AstralMed wishes to change the committed capacity down >10% (to avoid stranded capacity charges)

Tessa — you have my sign-off to proceed with the proposal we discussed. Send the redline-ready DocuSign to procurement once Legal signs off. CC Revenue Ops for billing instructions.

- Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
